title: Lead Gen: choose the structure
question: Same content and data, new look. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: One roster
options.lineage: Every specialist on one ruled sheet
options.thesis: Specialist performance, prospect conversion and resparks become one table, one row per specialist grouped by team, so a person's whole range reads across a single line.
materials: navy band with totals and source tabs
one wide ruled table with column groups
options.viewport: Navy band (Lead Gen, range in words, Live, the picker; the four totals; ALL SOURCES · INSTAGRAM · META BUSINESS tabs with Export and Schedules); then the Specialists table: PERFORMANCE · CONVERSION · RESPARK column groups, team rows with subtotals, a Total row; posts by team and raw submissions below.
options.risk: Fifteen figure columns: under about 1,400px the table shows one group at a time behind a Performance / Conversion / Respark toggle.

options.label: Funnel first
options.thesis: Prospect conversion leads as a stage strip (Prospects to Customer with the share kept at each step); specialists and top posts share the row under it, respark last.
materials: navy band with totals and source tabs
a ruled stage strip with step bars
specialist table beside a posts rail
options.viewport: Navy band as in One roster; a white Conversion strip of six stages (count, share of prospects, a bar) plus Deals; under it Specialists by team (submissions, per hour, a small conversion bar) beside a 384px Top posts rail with team tabs; Respark and raw submissions below.
options.risk: Puts conversion, the slowest-moving number, above the day's output; on Today the strip is mostly zeros.

options.label: One table at a time
options.thesis: Under the band one card holds the page's five tables behind tabs (Specialists, Conversion, Respark, Posts, Submissions), each at full width with no sideways scroll; the tab sits in the URL.
materials: navy band with totals and source tabs
options.viewport: Navy band as in One roster; one white card whose 44px title row is the tab list SPECIALISTS · CONVERSION · RESPARK · POSTS · SUBMISSIONS with counts; Specialists open by default as team groups with subtotals and a Total row.
options.risk: Calmest first screen, but comparing a specialist's output with their conversion means switching tabs.
